title: Universal Shadow Script
features: Keyless,Noclip,TPTOOL,Fov,Speed,Fly,Teleport,Key Engine,Esp,Theme,Shiftlock -CTRL- [photo didnt fit in] and a FPS Shower

comments.text: I tried using the script. This script is multi-functional. The only thing that should be changed is that the esp doesn't make the silhouette appear. The reason is that if you're using an item that becomes transparent, the silhouette won't appear. It's better to use the box for the esp. The keyboard doesn't work on smartphones. Fly flies in a random direction. Noclip doesn't turn off even when you turn it off. Save the settings before you turned off noclip and save the saved settings.Loading it will solve the problem.

@Smileskripts I tested your script! Honestly, except for the drag and noclip features (and fly), it’s almost flawless. 

Regarding the noclip feature, when it is turned off, it seems highly likely that all collision detections are being enabled at once. This causes bugs when walking around. To fix this, you should save the character's original collision state before activating noclip, and then load that saved state when turning it off.

As for the dragging system, I highly recommend creating your own custom drag script. (The code was obfuscated, so I couldn't check the details, though). 

Also, making the fly feature work smoothly on both Mobile and PC is quite difficult. Sorry for the long explanation! If you want to know how to make the fly behavior more stable, just let me know.

@Smileskripts Also, I confirmed that the Aimbot works, though I haven't tested it on PC yet. In my personal opinion, it's highly optimized and excellent! However, I couldn't figure out how to change the aim part (where it locks onto). If I just missed that setting, please let me know.

Regarding the fly feature, if you're having trouble with it, I can share my own script so you can check how the fly controls feel. But hey, don't copy the whole thing—we've got our pride as scripters, right? Haha!
@De*666 Thanks for checking my script now i am doing better ones thank you
